title: Chisel Carve Type
description: Letters carved into stone: dark text with a top inner highlight and bottom occlusion shadow inverted from the emboss formula, sitting on a speckled granite background built from layered radial gradients.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Cut
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
